verdict.rationale: Operating a remote-desktop product by natural-language commands is a fair axis, but the evidence shows only a scripted CLI with fixed parameters, a REST API, and an llms.txt docs index. None of these is a first-party natural-language command interface. The CLI, API and docs index are developer building blocks or adjacent features, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
